Korean Association for the Study of the Liver

recommendations.title: Gastric Cancer Screening — National Cancer Screening Program
recommendations.recommendation_text: Upper GI endoscopy or upper GI series barium study every 2 years for adults aged 40 and older. Covered under Korea's National Cancer Screening Program (NCSP).
recommendations.recommendation_text_ko: 만 40세 이상 성인에게 2년마다 위내시경 또는 위장조영검사 권장. 국가암검진 프로그램 적용.
recommendations.patient_facing_summary: In South Korea, gastric cancer screening (endoscopy) every 2 years is recommended starting at age 40 and is covered by national insurance. If you lived in Korea or are of Korean descent, discuss this with your US doctor — it may be appropriate regardless of where you live.
recommendations.patient_facing_summary_ko: 만 40세부터 2년마다 위내시경 검사를 받으시기 바랍니다. 국민건강보험에서 비용을 지원합니다.
recommendations.us_comparison_note: Gastric cancer screening is NOT routinely recommended in the US due to lower incidence. Korean-Americans and Korean immigrants may benefit from discussing endoscopy with their doctor given higher baseline risk.

recommendations.title: Liver Cancer Screening — National Cancer Screening Program
recommendations.recommendation_text: Liver ultrasound and alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) every 6 months for adults aged 40+ with hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or liver cirrhosis. Covered under NCSP.
recommendations.recommendation_text_ko: B형 간염, C형 간염 또는 간경변 있는 만 40세 이상 성인에게 6개월마다 간초음파 및 혈청 알파태아단백 검사 권장.
recommendations.patient_facing_summary: In South Korea, people with hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or cirrhosis age 40+ receive liver ultrasound and AFP blood test every 6 months to screen for liver cancer. Hepatitis B is more common in Korea — if you have hepatitis B, discuss liver cancer surveillance with your doctor.
recommendations.patient_facing_summary_ko: B형 간염, C형 간염 또는 간경변 있는 분들은 6개월마다 간초음파와 혈청 AFP 검사를 받으시기 바랍니다.
recommendations.us_comparison_note: AASLD also recommends HCC surveillance every 6 months for high-risk patients. US and Korean guidelines largely align on this topic.

recommendations.title: Colorectal Cancer Screening — National Cancer Screening Program
recommendations.recommendation_text: Annual fecal occult blood test (FOBT) for adults aged 50 and older. Colonoscopy if positive.
recommendations.recommendation_text_ko: 만 50세 이상 성인에게 매년 분변잠혈검사 권장. 양성 시 대장내시경 시행.
recommendations.patient_facing_summary: In South Korea, colorectal cancer screening with annual stool blood testing begins at age 50. A colonoscopy follows if the test is positive. Compare: US guidelines now recommend starting at age 45.
recommendations.patient_facing_summary_ko: 만 50세부터 매년 분변잠혈검사를 받으시기 바랍니다. 양성이면 대장내시경을 받아야 합니다.
recommendations.us_comparison_note: US USPSTF starts colorectal screening at age 45. Korea starts at 50 with annual FOBT. If you are 45–49, discuss screening with your US doctor.

recommendations.title: Breast Cancer Screening — National Cancer Screening Program
recommendations.recommendation_text: Mammography every 2 years for women aged 40 to 69.
recommendations.patient_facing_summary: In South Korea, mammography every 2 years is recommended for women 40–69. US USPSTF recommends the same starting at age 40. These guidelines largely align.
recommendations.us_comparison_note: US and Korean guidelines for breast cancer screening are similar. Both recommend mammography starting at 40 every 2 years.

recommendations.title: Cervical Cancer Screening — National Cancer Screening Program
recommendations.recommendation_text: Cervical cytology (Pap smear) every 2 years for women aged 20 and older.
recommendations.patient_facing_summary: In South Korea, Pap smear every 2 years starts at age 20. US guidelines start at age 21 every 3 years. If you received care in Korea, you may have started earlier and on a different interval.
recommendations.us_comparison_note: US USPSTF starts cervical screening at age 21 every 3 years. Korean guidelines start at 20 every 2 years. HPV co-testing is used differently.

recommendations.title: Type 2 Diabetes Screening
recommendations.recommendation_text: Screen for diabetes using fasting plasma glucose or A1c in adults 40 years or older, or younger adults with obesity, family history, hypertension, dyslipidemia, or gestational diabetes history.
recommendations.recommendation_text_ko: 만 40세 이상 성인, 또는 비만, 가족력, 고혈압, 이상지질혈증, 임신당뇨 병력이 있는 젊은 성인에게 공복혈당 또는 당화혈색소 선별검사 권장.
recommendations.patient_facing_summary: Korean Diabetes Association recommends diabetes screening starting at 40, or earlier with risk factors. A fasting glucose or A1c test is used.
recommendations.patient_facing_summary_ko: 대한당뇨병학회는 만 40세 이상 성인 또는 위험인자가 있는 성인에게 당뇨병 선별검사를 권장합니다.
recommendations.us_comparison_note: US USPSTF diabetes screening starts at 35 for overweight/obese. Korea KDA starts at 40 or earlier with risk factors. Both use fasting glucose or A1c.
